notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.3.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added new [b]Shake FX[/b] option to activate or deactivate screen shakes & flash effects in game
[*]Reduced screen shakes amount and duration when new [b]Shake FX[/b] option is activated
[*]Changed Gamepad deadzone value for more precise control response with analog sticks
[/list]
